definitions.gloss: in a fluster; hurriedly; in a panic
definitions.explanation: An onomatopoeic adverb describing a state of flustered, panicky movement, rushing about without composure.

examples.japanese: あたふた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}する→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧。
⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れ→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧そうで、あたふた⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: I was about to miss the train, so I ran about frantically.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な⟦{来客|らいきゃく}→来客：13061_raikyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あたふた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}け→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Caught off guard by unexpected guests, my mother frantically started tidying up the room.

notes:
An onomatopoeic adverb (⟦オノマトペ→オノマトペ：22607_onomatope⟧) conveying the image of someone rushing around in a flustered, disorganized manner. Often used with the particle ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧.

USAGE:
- あたふた⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be in a fluster — used as a suru verb)
- あたふた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (in a fluster — used as an adverb modifying a verb)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- あたふた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧ (flee in a panic)
- あたふた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{支度|したく}する→支度する：01828_shitakusuru⟧ (get ready in a rush)
- あたふた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}る→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧ (run around frantically)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦おろおろ→おろおろ：05369_orooro⟧ — being at a loss, confused and helpless (less action-oriented, more standing in bewilderment)
- ⟦ばたばた→ばたばた：05353_batabata⟧ — rushing about busily (can be neutral busy-ness, not necessarily panicked)
- ⟦そわそわ→そわそわ：05267_sowasowa⟧ — restlessly, fidgeting (anxiety-based rather than action-based)
- ⟦{大慌|おおあわ}て→大慌て：20600_ooawate⟧ — great panic (noun describing the same state)
